messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: lighter source distributions
parts:
Much to my chagrin, I notice that PyStan unnecessarily redistributes the
following pieces of Stan source along with PyStan:

25M ./stan/src/test
7.4M ./stan/logos
51M ./stan/doc

I thought I'd share this in case it crops up for other wrapping software. I had
no idea Stan had 25M of tests. Or 7.4M of logos.

Best,

-a

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] lighter source distributions
parts:
I think it makes sense to only distribute the doxygen-generated
API doc with the Stan C++ distribution.

I'm not sure how we got 25M of tests unless there's a lot of
auto-generated code in there. We're not that prolific!

The logos include all the raw vector graphics. Don't really need
to distribute those, at all. I'm not sure if we do with the
tarball we build for CmdStan.

- Bob
